name: scraping-bot
description: Scrape web pages, products, real estate, travel, search engines and social media with ScrapingBot.
long_description: Lets Claude fetch public web pages through ScrapingBot's proxies and headless browsers, and extract structured data: product pages (price, stock, brand), real estate listings, hotels and rentals, Google and Bing results, and public Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Threads pages. Also shows your remaining credits and usage. You need a ScrapingBot account: the free plan gives 500 credits a month.
